paragraphs.text: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),
paragraphs.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος, οὐκ ἀπʼ ἀνθρώπων οὐδὲ διʼ ἀνθρώπου ἀλλὰ διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ θεοῦ πατρὸς τοῦ ἐγείραντος αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν,
paragraphs.translit: Paulos apostolos, ouk apʼ anthrōpōn oude diʼ anthrōpou alla dia Iēsou Christou kai theou patros tou egeirantos auton ek nekrōn,

paragraphs.text: and all the brethren that are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
paragraphs.original: καὶ οἱ σὺν ἐμοὶ πάντες ἀδελφοί, ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας·
paragraphs.translit: kai hoi syn emoi pantes adelphoi, tais ekklēsiais tēs Galatias·

paragraphs.text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,
paragraphs.original: χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,
paragraphs.translit: charis hymin kai eirēnē apo theou patros kai kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou,

paragraphs.text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil world, according to the will of our God and Father:
paragraphs.original: τοῦ δόντος ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν ἡμῶν ὅπως ἐξέληται ἡμᾶς ἐκ τοῦ αἰῶνος τοῦ ἐνεστῶτος πονηροῦ κατὰ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ πατρὸς ἡμῶν,
paragraphs.translit: tou dontos heauton hyper tōn hamartiōn hēmōn hopōs exelētai hēmas ek tou aiōnos tou enestōtos ponērou kata to thelēma tou theou kai patros hēmōn,

paragraphs.text: to whom [be] the glory for ever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: ᾧ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: hō hē doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn· amēn.

paragraphs.text: I marvel that ye are so quickly removing from him that called you in the grace of Christ unto a different gospel;
paragraphs.original: Θαυμάζω ὅτι οὕτως ταχέως μετατίθεσθε ἀπὸ τοῦ καλέσαντος ὑμᾶς ἐν χάριτι Χριστοῦ εἰς ἕτερον εὐαγγέλιον,
paragraphs.translit: Thaumazō hoti houtōs tacheōs metatithesthe apo tou kalesantos hymas en chariti Christou eis heteron euangelion,

paragraphs.text: which is not another [gospel] only there are some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.
paragraphs.original: ὃ οὐκ ἔστιν ἄλλο· εἰ μή τινές εἰσιν οἱ ταράσσοντες ὑμᾶς καὶ θέλοντες μεταστρέψαι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: ho ouk estin allo· ei mē tines eisin hoi tarassontes hymas kai thelontes metastrepsai to euangelion tou Christou.

paragraphs.text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach unto you any gospel other than that which we preached unto you, let him be anathema.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐὰν ἡμεῖς ἢ ἄγγελος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εὐαγγελίζηται ὑμῖν παρʼ ὃ εὐηγγελισάμεθα ὑμῖν, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.
paragraphs.translit: alla kai ean hēmeis ē angelos ex ouranou euangelizētai hymin parʼ ho euēngelisametha hymin, anathema estō.

paragraphs.text: As we have said before, so say I now again, if any man preacheth unto you any gospel other than that which ye received, let him be anathema.
paragraphs.original: ὡς προειρήκαμεν, καὶ ἄρτι πάλιν λέγω, εἴ τις ὑμᾶς εὐαγγελίζεται παρʼ ὃ παρελάβετε, ἀνάθεμα ἔστω.
paragraphs.translit: hōs proeirēkamen, kai arti palin legō, ei tis hymas euangelizetai parʼ ho parelabete, anathema estō.

paragraphs.text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? or am I striving to please men? if I were still pleasing men, I should not be a servant of Christ.
paragraphs.original: Ἄρτι γὰρ ἀνθρώπους πείθω ἢ τὸν θεόν; ἢ ζητῶ ἀνθρώποις ἀρέσκειν; εἰ ἔτι ἀνθρώποις ἤρεσκον, Χριστοῦ δοῦλος οὐκ ἂν ἤμην.
paragraphs.translit: Arti gar anthrōpous peithō ē ton theon; ē zētō anthrōpois areskein; ei eti anthrōpois ēreskon, Christou doulos ouk an ēmēn.

paragraphs.text: For I make known to you, brethren, as touching the gospel which was preached by me, that it is not after man.
paragraphs.original: Γνωρίζω γὰρ ὑμῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τὸ εὐαγγελισθὲν ὑπʼ ἐμοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν κατὰ ἄνθρωπον·
paragraphs.translit: Gnōrizō gar hymin, adelphoi, to euangelion to euangelisthen hypʼ emou hoti ouk estin kata anthrōpon·

paragraphs.text: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but [it came to me] through revelation of Jesus Christ.
paragraphs.original: οὐδὲ γὰρ ἐγὼ παρὰ ἀνθρώπου παρέλαβον αὐτό, οὔτε ἐδιδάχθην, ἀλλὰ διʼ ἀποκαλύψεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: oude gar egō para anthrōpou parelabon auto, oute edidachthēn, alla diʼ apokalypseōs Iēsou Christou.

paragraphs.text: For ye have heard of my manner of life in time past in the Jews` religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God, and made havoc of it:
paragraphs.original: Ἠκούσατε γὰρ τὴν ἐμὴν ἀναστροφήν ποτε ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ, ὅτι καθʼ ὑπερβολὴν ἐδίωκον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπόρθουν αὐτήν,
paragraphs.translit: Ēkousate gar tēn emēn anastrophēn pote en tō Ioudaismō, hoti kathʼ hyperbolēn ediōkon tēn ekklēsian tou theou kai eporthoun autēn,

paragraphs.text: and I advanced in the Jews` religion beyond many of mine own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.
paragraphs.original: καὶ προέκοπτον ἐν τῷ Ἰουδαϊσμῷ ὑπὲρ πολλοὺς συνηλικιώτας ἐν τῷ γένει μου, περισσοτέρως ζηλωτὴς ὑπάρχων τῶν πατρικῶν μου παραδόσεων.
paragraphs.translit: kai proekopton en tō Ioudaismō hyper pollous synēlikiōtas en tō genei mou, perissoterōs zēlōtēs hyparchōn tōn patrikōn mou paradoseōn.

paragraphs.text: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me, [even] from my mother`s womb, and called me through his grace,
paragraphs.original: ὅτε δὲ εὐδόκησεν ὁ ἀφορίσας με ἐκ κοιλίας μητρός μου καὶ καλέσας διὰ τῆς χάριτος αὐτοῦ
paragraphs.translit: hote de eudokēsen ho aphorisas me ek koilias mētros mou kai kalesas dia tēs charitos autou

paragraphs.text: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles; straightway I conferred not with flesh and blood:
paragraphs.original: ἀποκαλύψαι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἵνα εὐαγγελίζωμαι αὐτὸν ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, εὐθέως οὐ προσανεθέμην σαρκὶ καὶ αἵματι,
paragraphs.translit: apokalypsai ton hyion autou en emoi hina euangelizōmai auton en tois ethnesin, eutheōs ou prosanethemēn sarki kai haimati,

paragraphs.text: neither went I up to Jerusalem to them that were apostles before me: but I went away into Arabia; and again I returned unto Damascus.
paragraphs.original: οὐδὲ ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα πρὸς τοὺς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἀποστόλους, ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθον εἰς Ἀραβίαν, καὶ πάλιν ὑπέστρεψα εἰς Δαμασκόν.
paragraphs.translit: oude anēlthon eis Hierosolyma pros tous pro emou apostolous, alla apēlthon eis Arabian, kai palin hypestrepsa eis Damaskon.

paragraphs.text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas, and tarried with him fifteen days.
paragraphs.original: Ἔπειτα μετὰ ἔτη τρία ἀνῆλθον εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἱστορῆσαι Κηφᾶν, καὶ ἐπέμεινα πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡμέρας δεκαπέντε·
paragraphs.translit: Epeita meta etē tria anēlthon eis Hierosolyma historēsai Kēphan, kai epemeina pros auton hēmeras dekapente·

paragraphs.text: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord`s brother.
paragraphs.original: ἕτερον δὲ τῶν ἀποστόλων οὐκ εἶδον, εἰ μὴ Ἰάκωβον τὸν ἀδελφὸν τοῦ κυρίου.
paragraphs.translit: heteron de tōn apostolōn ouk eidon, ei mē Iakōbon ton adelphon tou kyriou.

paragraphs.text: Now touching the things which I write unto you, behold, before God, I lie not.
paragraphs.original: ἃ δὲ γράφω ὑμῖν, ἰδοὺ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θεοῦ ὅτι οὐ ψεύδομαι.
paragraphs.translit: ha de graphō hymin, idou enōpion tou theou hoti ou pseudomai.

paragraphs.text: Then I came unto the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
paragraphs.original: ἔπειτα ἦλθον εἰς τὰ κλίματα τῆς Συρίας καὶ τῆς Κιλικίας.
paragraphs.translit: epeita ēlthon eis ta klimata tēs Syrias kai tēs Kilikias.

paragraphs.text: And I was still unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
paragraphs.original: ἤμην δὲ ἀγνοούμενος τῷ προσώπῳ ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Ἰουδαίας ταῖς ἐν Χριστῷ,
paragraphs.translit: ēmēn de agnooumenos tō prosōpō tais ekklēsiais tēs Ioudaias tais en Christō,

paragraphs.text: but they only heard say, He that once persecuted us now preacheth the faith of which he once made havoc;
paragraphs.original: μόνον δὲ ἀκούοντες ἦσαν ὅτι Ὁ διώκων ἡμᾶς ποτε νῦν εὐαγγελίζεται τὴν πίστιν ἥν ποτε ἐπόρθει,
paragraphs.translit: monon de akouontes ēsan hoti Ho diōkōn hēmas pote nyn euangelizetai tēn pistin hēn pote eporthei,

paragraphs.text: and they glorified God in me.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐδόξαζον ἐν ἐμοὶ τὸν θεόν.
paragraphs.translit: kai edoxazon en emoi ton theon.
